rr-gagen.st: Jones & McVean (1924) say Dan Gagen's station at Gagen Hill, about 30 miles from Pelican Rapids, was a stop on the Wausau-Ontonagon mail road.
src: Jones & McVean, History of Lincoln, Oneida and Vilas Counties (1924)

sf-hayward-lavell-house-hotel.st: Lilliquist (1978): the Lavelle House later became the Drake Hotel. Other Hayward hotels were the Central House, the Ferguson, Lessard's Hotel and Saloon, and the Giblin Hotel; saloons on Main and 1st Streets included Carlson's, Tonstad's, Weigle's, Charlie Peterson's, Johnnie Johnson's, Pennel's and Jeter's.
src: Lilliquist, Swedetown, Dogtown and Swamp Street (1978)

vf-summerwind.st: Jones & McVean (1924) say West Bay Lake was a homestead on the Cisco chain that became the West Bay Lake Resort, a hotel and 4 cottages, running until 1917. The book has nothing on Lamont beyond a biography line, and nothing on Keefer or treasure.
src: Jones & McVean, History of Lincoln, Oneida and Vilas Counties (1924)
